data.title: Timeline dates: explicit start/due on a task, else derived from its descendants and their sprints; actual from history
data.why: A future epic with no work in a sprint yet still needs a bar, so explicit dates exist; without them the plan follows the work. Where explicit and derived disagree the mismatch is shown, not settled. Actual comes from when tasks really started and finished.
data.rejected: Only explicit dates, as Jira: the plan drifts from the work it groups; Only derived dates: an epic with nothing scheduled under it has no bar
